_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "uses_index_php" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("uses_index_php" IN (0, 1)), "cert_pin_sha256" TEXT NULL, "allow_http_lan" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_http_lan" IN (0, 1)), "server_caps" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "scopes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "token_expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "station_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "remote_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "callsign" TEXT NOT NULL, "gridsquare" TEXT NULL, "dxcc" INTEGER NULL, "cqz" INTEGER NULL, "ituz" INTEGER NULL, "sota_ref" TEXT NULL, "pota_ref" TEXT NULL, "wwff_ref" TEXT NULL, "iota" TEXT NULL, "sig" TEXT NULL, "sig_info" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("account_id", "remote_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contest_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cabrillo_name" TEXT NULL, "wavelog_adif_name" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "definition" TEXT NOT NULL, "builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("builtin" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contest_sessions" ("origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc_created" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc_modified" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contest_definitions (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "station_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES station_profiles (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "settings" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "remote_session_id" INTEGER NULL, "serial_strategy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'single', "serial_range_start" INTEGER NULL, "serial_range_end" INTEGER NULL, "remote_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "remote_end_synced" INTEGER NULL, "remote_error_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activations" ("origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc_created" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc_modified" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "program" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NOT NULL, "my_gridsquare" TEXT NULL, "station_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES station_profiles (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "qsos" ("origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc_created" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc_modified" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "station_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES station_profiles (id), "call" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_off" INTEGER NULL, "band" TEXT NOT NULL, "band_rx" TEXT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "submode" TEXT NULL, "freq_hz" INTEGER NULL, "freq_rx_hz" INTEGER NULL, "rst_sent" TEXT NULL, "rst_rcvd" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "qth" TEXT NULL, "gridsquare" TEXT NULL, "dxcc" INTEGER NULL, "cqz" INTEGER NULL, "ituz" INTEGER NULL, "state" TEXT NULL, "cnty" TEXT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "cont" TEXT NULL, "darc_dok" TEXT NULL, "iota" TEXT NULL, "sota_ref" TEXT NULL, "pota_ref" TEXT NULL, "wwff_ref" TEXT NULL, "sig" TEXT NULL, "sig_info" TEXT NULL, "my_sota_ref" TEXT NULL, "my_pota_ref" TEXT NULL, "my_wwff_ref" TEXT NULL, "my_sig" TEXT NULL, "my_sig_info" TEXT NULL, "station_callsign" TEXT NULL, "operator" TEXT NULL, "my_gridsquare" TEXT NULL, "tx_pwr" REAL NULL, "contest_id" TEXT NULL, "srx" INTEGER NULL, "stx" INTEGER NULL, "srx_string" TEXT NULL, "stx_string" TEXT NULL, "check" TEXT NULL, "class" TEXT NULL, "precedence" TEXT NULL, "arrl_sect" TEXT NULL, "prop_mode" TEXT NULL, "sat_name" TEXT NULL, "sat_mode" TEXT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "qsl_via" TEXT NULL, "adif_extra" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "contest_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES contest_sessions (id), "activation_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES activations (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "qso_sync" ("qso_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qsos (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'create', "remote_qso_id" INTEGER NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "last_error_key" TEXT NULL, "server_message" TEXT NULL, "synced_rev" INTEGER NULL, "synced_hash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("qso_id", "account_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_journal" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "qso_id" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contest_links" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contest_sessions (id), "qso_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qsos (id), "remote_qso_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "linked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "qso_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "serial_allocations" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contest_sessions (id), "serial" INTEGER NOT NULL, "qso_id" TEXT NULL, "allocated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "serial"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_rules" ("program" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rules" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("program"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reference_packs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "region_filter" TEXT NULL, "licence_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dxcc_entities" ("dxcc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "prefix" TEXT NOT NULL, "cqz" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ituz" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cont" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("dxcc"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dxcc_prefixes" ("prefix_or_call" TEXT NOT NULL, "exact" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("exact" IN (0, 1)), "dxcc" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dxcc_entities (dxcc), "cqz_override" INTEGER NULL, "ituz_override" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("prefix_or_call", "exact"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_references" ("program" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, "lat" REAL NULL, "lon" REAL NULL, "valid_from" INTEGER NULL, "valid_to" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("program", "ref"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scp_calls" ("call" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("call"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "worked_before" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "call" TEXT NOT NULL, "band" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "dxcc" INTEGER NULL, "gridsquare" TEXT NULL, "first_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("account_id", "call", "band", "mode"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "public_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "paired_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revoked_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "peer_cursors" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "last_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shortcut_bindings" ("command_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "binding" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("command_id", "platform"));
CREATE INDEX qsos_account_time ON qsos (account_id, time_on)
CREATE INDEX qsos_call ON qsos (call)
CREATE INDEX qsos_contest_session ON qsos (contest_session_id)
CREATE INDEX qso_sync_account_state ON qso_sync (account_id, state)
CREATE INDEX sync_journal_account_at ON sync_journal (account_id, at)
